fr-monstre.scope: MONSTRE, Académie 9e: XII century, Latin monstrum; modern senses including monstre sacré.

en-monster.scope: Middle English/Anglo-French/Latin transmission; noun first-known 14th century, adjective 1837, sense-specific.

fr-presser.scope: TLFi PRESSER: ca1160 torment, ca1200 olives/crowd; 1557 urgency. Latin pressare intensive of premere. Accessed via inflected URL.

fr-pression.scope: PRESSION: XIII century, Latin pressio from pressum/premere; modern physical and technical pressure.

en-recognize.scope: Anglo-French reconois-/reconoistre and Latin recognoscere. 1537 first-known formal acknowledgement sense, not all senses.

fr-reconnaitre.scope: TLFi RECONNAÎTRE accessible inflected entry: Latin recognoscere, late 10th-century reconnostre; identification, acknowledgement, gratitude constructions.

lumen.scope: Lewis & Short lūmen: classical light/lamp and transferred clarity senses; Cic. Div. 2.42.91; De orat. 2.86.353. Lexicographic order is not dated chronology.

lux.scope: Lewis & Short lux: sunlight/day; Cic. Div. 1.3.6; Caes. BG 1.22; public view and life. Retrieved via urllib after browser extraction failure; not the SI unit.
